current_reference_evidence.limits: Eight human-reference sentences per measured direction; relative lexical evidence only, not semantic accuracy or a blanket runtime ranking.

prior_observations.availability: Google was throttled; 396 Bing and 12 MyMemory Oromo completions, no fair independent quality comparison.

critical_errors.issue: 0.5 mg, not 5 mg became not 0.5 but 5
critical_errors.runtime_rule: Reject reversed unique Amharic numeric contrast; select complete correct contrast only

critical_errors.issue: minus 5 rendered as below 5, sign meaning unresolved
critical_errors.runtime_rule: Signed source details require explicit matched polarity before automatic candidate acceptance

prior_observations.limits: Developer-reviewed synthetic passages; neither grades nor completion imply native accuracy or broad provider superiority.
